title: Node.js Leak-Hunt Plan
description: A structured plan for hunting a Node.js memory leak — RSS shape, chosen technique, snapshot target, metric coverage — so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/node_memory_leak_hunting_audit.mjs.

leakConfirmed.description: True if the reporter believes a genuine leak is confirmed (not heap pressure, not a plateau at the ceiling).

rssPattern.description: The observed memory-curve shape, per the confirm-before-chasing table. Only monotonic and flat-rss-heap-climbing justify a snapshot hunt.

plannedTechnique.description: The primary technique for this hunt. scheduled-restart always fails the audit; raise-max-old-space fails on monotonic growth.

loadDrivenBetweenSnapshots.description: True if the suspect path is exercised (k6, curl loop, real traffic) between snapshot 1 and snapshot 2. Required for two-snapshot-diff.

snapshotTarget.description: Which process gets the synchronous heap-walk pause. Never the busy primary.

metricsTracked.description: process.memoryUsage() series exported to metrics. heap_used, heap_total, rss, and external are all required.

sourceMapsEnabled.description: True if the process runs with --enable-source-maps so retainer chains resolve to real source positions.

scheduledRestartMasking.description: True if an existing cron/PM2/liveness restart is currently masking the leak.
